a_generation: fresh from each checkpoint, question only
eos_policy: Allowed; EOS included in prediction entropy but excluded from averages; incomplete windows null
instruction: Solve the problem using the current information. Perform only the arithmetic needed and give the numerical answer. Do not restate the problem, repeat the correction, or add introductory text.
metric: Entropy ablations, bits/token; source conditions full, empty correction, empty A

specification.accuracy_protocol: Publisher's full 1319 test questions, 10-shot greedy, non-thinking. Not measured by this entropy experiment. Intermediate score not unambiguously mapped in model card.
limitations: Public sequential GRPO stages, not a controlled sweep of unique GSM8K training-set sizes.
Learning rate, rollout group size, and sampling temperature change across stages.
Publisher selected the r5 initialization using 200 test questions; this is not an untouched test benchmark.
The original 50 questions were length-screened; the added 150 are randomly sampled without length screening.
Original question-only prompts and 20+20 token entropy protocol are retained, so published accuracy is selection context, not this run's accuracy.
specification.name: qwen06b_gsm8k200
specification.training_exposure_note: Inferred as cumulative optimizer steps times 16 prompts per step. Distinct IDs were not independently verified. r5 descends from r2 (77 steps), r4-s100 (100 more), then r5 (74 more).
